parameters.name: CurrentPage
parameters.description: The page number of the page to return.

parameters.name: IotInstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID. You can view the **ID** of the instance on the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.

><notice>
- If this value exists, you must specify it. Otherwise, the call fails.
- If <props="intl"><ph>the **Overview** page or </ph></props>this value does not exist, you do not need to specify it.

></notice>

For more information about instances, see [Overview](~~356505~~).

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of records per page. Maximum value: 50.

sub_parameters.name: TagKey
sub_parameters.description: The key of the product tag.

sub_parameters.name: TagValue
sub_parameters.description: The value of the product tag.
